args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they were trapped in a temporal loop that lasts approximately one hour [2]. When the loop ends, it starts again, and anyone inside who cannot "feel" the loop forgets the entire turn and relives it fresh [2]. Consequently, these parties are not dead, but are still walking into the building every hour, having been trapped for nine years [2].

The mechanism behind this phenomenon is as follows:
*   **Cause:** The Lumen Concern attempted to dig for lumen and instead struck "the Whole," which caused space to fold and time to become caught [5]. This event caused the building to collapse during the first turn of the loop, and it has continued to collapse during every subsequent turn since [5].
*   **Memory and Reset:** At the end of each hour, the loop resets everyone who cannot "hold the deep Facets back" to the top of the stairs [7]. Because these individuals forget each turn, they cannot escape [2].
*   **Ode Marran's Exception:** Unlike the others, Odeline Marran can remember every turn because she is one of the few whom the loop cannot reset [7]. Having lived the same hour for nine years, she has watched the shaft fold and unfold thousands of times, allowing her to know the timing of the loop to the breath [6, 7].
